stories.title: Deja 2 muertos otra riña en penal de Mazatlán

en.title: Another brawl leaves 2 dead in Mazatlán prison
en.summary: A fight at El Castillo prison in Mazatlán, Sinaloa resulted in two inmate deaths, according to state security authorities.

stories.title: Netanyahu acusa al Comité Nobel de haber "perdido su brújula moral"; reacciona tras Nobel de la Paz a Navi Pillay

en.title: Netanyahu accuses Nobel Committee of having "lost its moral compass"; reacts after Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay
en.summary: Israel's prime minister criticized the Nobel Committee's decision to award the Peace Prize to Navi Pillay, claiming she built her career spreading accusations against Israel.

stories.title: Trump sanciona a la Corte Penal Internacional; responde así tras Nobel de la Paz a Navi Pillay, exjueza de la CPI

en.title: Trump sanctions the International Criminal Court; responds after Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay, former ICC judge
en.summary: The U.S. government announced additional measures to defend American sovereignty and counter what it describes as the threat posed by the International Criminal Court.

stories.title: Trump hace eco de críticas a la nueva Nobel de la Paz Navi Pillay; el mandatario estadounidense dice que él se merece el premio

en.title: Trump echoes criticism of new Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay; U.S. president says he deserves the award
en.summary: The U.S. president joined criticism of Navi Pillay's Nobel Peace Prize selection, asserting that he should have received the honor instead.

stories.title: Navi Pillay, la mujer que desafió al apartheid, ayudó a Mandela y ganó el Nobel de la Paz; "hay que atreverse a alzar la voz"

en.title: Navi Pillay, the woman who defied apartheid, helped Mandela and won the Nobel Peace Prize; "one must dare to raise one's voice"
en.summary: South African jurist Navi Pillay, 85, received the Nobel Peace Prize following decades of work against discrimination, including efforts during apartheid and support for Mandela.

stories.title: VIDEO: Navi Pillay, nueva Nobel de la Paz, bromea con entregar su galardón a Trump; Corina Machado le dio el suyo al presidente de EU

en.title: VIDEO: Navi Pillay, new Nobel Peace Prize winner, jokes about giving her award to Trump; Corina Machado gave hers to the US president
en.summary: Navi Pillay, the new Nobel Peace Prize recipient, made jokes regarding transferring her award to Trump, referencing Corina Machado's decision to give hers to the US president.

stories.title: Israel afirma que "Goebbels aplaude desde el infierno" el Nobel de la Paz 2026 a Navi Pillay

en.title: Israel claims "Goebbels applauds from hell" the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay
en.summary: The Israeli government criticized the Nobel Peace Prize given to South African jurist Navanethem Pillay, comparing it to Nazi propaganda minister Joseph Goebbels' approval.

stories.title: Huracán Isaías se fortalece a categoría 3 rumbo a las costas de EU en el Golfo de México

en.title: Hurricane Isaías strengthens to category 3 heading toward US coasts in the Gulf of Mexico
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías intensified to category 3 on Friday while moving toward United States coastlines in the Gulf of Mexico.

stories.title: Navi Pillay dedica su Nobel de la Paz 2026 a "los supervivientes de crímenes internacionales"

en.title: Navi Pillay dedicates her 2026 Nobel Peace Prize to "survivors of international crimes"
en.summary: South African judge Navi Pillay, the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize winner, dedicated her award to survivors of international crimes during her first public appearance after the prize was announced.

stories.title: Navi Pillay dedica su Nobel de la Paz a "los sobrevivientes de crímenes internacionales"; denuncia ataques contra la CPI

en.title: Navi Pillay dedicates her Nobel Peace Prize to "survivors of international crimes"; denounces attacks against the ICC
en.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Navi Pillay dedicated the award to survivors of international crimes and criticized attacks targeting the International Criminal Court.

stories.title: Gana Navi Pillay el Nobel de la Paz

en.title: Navi Pillay wins the Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: South African human rights pioneer Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize for her work promoting peace through efforts to advance human rights.

stories.title: Riña en penal de Sinaloa deja 9 reos y un menor muertos

en.title: Prison Fight in Sinaloa Leaves 9 Inmates and One Child Dead
en.summary: A riot at El Castillo penitentiary in Mazatlán, Sinaloa resulted in nine inmate deaths and one visiting two-year-old child killed, along with 16 other inmates injured.

stories.title: Nissan se suma a otras 9 marcas tradicionales que importan autos desde China para abastecer a México

en.title: Nissan joins 9 other traditional automakers importing cars from China to supply Mexico
en.summary: Nissan launched its first model developed and manufactured in China for global export, the Frontier PRO PHEV, joining other major manufacturers already importing thousands of vehicles from China to Mexico.

stories.title: AriZona cambia de cancha: de su famoso té a bebidas con 5% de alcohol para conquistar otro mercado

en.title: AriZona shifts focus: from its famous tea to alcoholic beverages with 5% alcohol to conquer another market
en.summary: AriZona is expanding beyond its traditional tea products to include beverages made with tequila, while maintaining the fruity flavors associated with the brand.

stories.title: De Dr. Simi a Bienestar: las marcas que ahora tienen cafetería aunque su negocio original sea otro

en.title: From Dr. Simi to Bienestar: brands that now have cafes despite their original business being different
en.summary: Several non-coffee brands are diversifying into cafe operations, with some opening permanent locations and others using temporary cafes for product promotion and market access.

stories.title: Cobrar una incapacidad del IMSS ya no será igual para todos: este monto cambia la forma de pago

en.title: Collecting IMSS disability benefits will no longer be the same for everyone: this amount changes the payment method
en.summary: Mexico's social security system has implemented a new payment scheme for disability benefits that requires bank accounts in certain cases, though the benefit amounts remain unchanged.

stories.title: Los contratos mixtos no atraen a los gigantes petroleros, pero algunas empresas sí ven negocio con Pemex

en.title: Mixed contracts do not attract major oil companies, but some firms do see business opportunity with Pemex
en.summary: While large petroleum companies avoid mixed contracts with Mexico's state oil company, smaller firms like Consorcio 5M del Golfo are securing fields under this arrangement, though they express concerns about its suitability for all projects.
